item.title: Lord of Undead
item.description:
Title: Lord of Undead
Genre: Action , Adventure , Indie , RPG , Early Access
Developer: Megame LLC
Publisher: Megame LLC
Release Date: Nov 18, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Nov 18, 2026




About This Game

You are the spirit of an ancient dark sorcerer, banished from the mortal realm centuries ago. But now, these fools have dared to summon you back. Assemble your army of death - the time for vengeance has come!

SUMMON THE UNDEAD

You have been granted power over the dead, for you are the Lord of the Undead .

Create various types of minions: from simple skeletons and zombies to wraiths and plague creatures.

Craft weapons and armor for them, level them up, and strengthen your army.

Your minions can carry out various orders. They can be tasked with gathering resources or defending your base. Or, you can command them to raze a human village to the ground…

RECLAIM YOUR POWER

Restore your former strength by consuming mortal souls, crafting equipment from found resources, and learning new talents.

Choose your path of progression: dark magic, archery, heavy weapons and armor - or combine them all.

Customize your character to fit your playstyle and use a rich set of abilities to leave those pathetic mortals no chance at all.

BUILD YOUR DARK BASE

A flexible building system and a variety of structures and workbenches are at your disposal.

But before you build - desecrate the land!

Place Pylons of Darkness in strategic locations and reshape the landscape to suit a dark lord.

On desecrated ground, you and your minions grow stronger, buildings can regenerate, and resources produce dark essence.

ANNIHILATE THE MORTALS

Wipe out entire human settlements, establish your outposts there, and claim their resources.

Create an invincible army of death and lead it through the mortal lands, carry out your dark deeds, and let the whole world fall.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

You have a sword, your enemies have a body and soul. Kill the body, take their souls.



System Requirements

Windows

* Starting January 1st, 2024, the Steam Client will only support Windows 10 and later versions.
    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS *: Windows 7 (64-bit) or newer
    • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Phenom
    • Memory: 6 GB RAM
    • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050
    • Storage: 6 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or newer
    • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3070
    • Storage: 6 GB available space

item.title: KORRIDOR
item.description:
Title: KORRIDOR
Genre: Action , Casual , Indie
Developer: TinyToad
Publisher: TARK
Release Date: Nov 18, 2026




About This Game

Korridor is based off those mobile shooter games everyone has seen , turning them into a deeply strategic genre by mixing in elements of roguelikes and bullet heavens!

As the game progresses you are continuously defining your build by picking up items every 15 seconds!
Choose between 35 powerful runes and 100+ shop items to hone your playstyle and twist the game rules.

If you make it to the endless mode, you may scale infinitely and compete in our Leaderboard!


Enjoy a custom 45-minutes electro-metal soundtrack as you slay hordes of raving monsters.

Experience bursts of intense gameplay while facing Demon Rushes and six Boss Fights!


The shops between levels are filled with real historical characters and trivia from the High Middle Ages! As you navigate and delve deeper, fill out a Picture Book and learn the secrets of the Catacombs. If you look closely, you might find treasure and secret interactions.






Time to beat: 20-45 hours.

This game is 100% human-made. No Gen-AI was used in making any of the graphical or audio assets.

System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043)
    • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support, Arm64
    • Memory: 500 MB RAM
    • Graphics: DX10
    • DirectX: Version 10
    • Storage: 700 MB available space
    Recommended:
    • OS: Windows 11
    • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support, Arm64
    • Memory: 2 GB RAM
    • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 or Vulkan capable GPUs
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 700 MB available space

item.title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea
item.description:
Title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea
Genre: Action , Adventure , Casual , RPG , Simulation
Developer: Gameloft
Publisher: Gameloft
Release Date: Nov 18, 2026




About This Content

Includes 5,000 Moonstones

A mysterious statue appears in the water with a simple message: An old friend is lost and stranded. To save them, embark on a thrilling adventure beyond the coast of Dreamlight Valley and transform into magical merfolk to dive into the depths below! Seek the Guardians protecting treasures of a long forgotten past and get ready to explore the Keepsake Sea.

Transform Into Magical Merfolk

Become a creature of the sea and swim above or under the waters with over 50 options of customizable fins, tails, ears, and more! Express yourself in a variety of new underwater styles encompassing everything from a mystical mermaid princess to a cool deep-ocean dweller.

Jumping in the water also comes with some special perks, like easily gathering underwater materials for crafting or grabbing fish directly from fishing spots!

Befriend Five New Villagers and a Companion for Your Adventures

Uncover the secrets of this new world with a little help from cartographer and linguist Milo Thatch. Learn how to navigate the seas with none other than Captain Jack Sparrow! Cross paths with Megara, whose trust you'll really have to earn... And run alongside Wendy as you escape the clutches of Captain Hook! There's also plenty of fish in the sea, including the forgetful and curious Dory!

Uncover Three Island Biomes and New Underwater Worlds

Dock your ship on the piers of Shipwreck Shores, a pirate bay with a mysterious fortress area to uncover. Cross the waters to Candy Cove, a chilly dessert island with plenty of sweet treats. And swim to the Kingdom of Oublié, a dazzling coral city where you'll uncover the secrets of the sea.

That's not all! Dive below the waters to reveal an underwater world for you to discover—and make your own! Like above-water areas, underwater areas are customizable, allowing for tons of decorating with unique Disney- and Pixar-inspired items.

Sail on Your Own Enchanted Pirate Ship

Traverse between Islands on your very own enchanted pirate ship! Invite Villagers to come aboard and use your ship to salvage items from the depths below. As Captain, you'll be able to customize your ship, decorate your own private quarters and design your own pirate flag!

    Recommended:

    • DirectX: Version 11

item.title: Trust Your Gut
item.description:
Title: Trust Your Gut
Genre: Indie , Simulation , Strategy
Developer: Mishleto
Publisher: Caspianborn Publishing
Release Date: Nov 18, 2026




About This Game

TRUST YOUR GUT is a multi-ball roulette rogue-lite. Stack mementos and balls, place your bets, spin the wheel, and survive one more day.

Inspired by Clover Pit, Balatro, and Buckshot Roulette, combine Mementos with unique Ball abilities to create powerful synergies and builds. Pay off your debt, make it to the end of the show, and when you've finally earned your freedom, can you stop?

Features:

  • Multi-ball roulette with powerful synergies and builds.

  • 100+ Mementos and 50+ Ball variants.

  • Offers that change the rules.

  • Countless ways to manipulate the odds.

  • 4 playable characters with different playstyles.

  • Showdowns that throw your run into chaos.

  • Campaign and Endless modes.

  • Leaderboards to push your score higher.

For those who believe bad luck ruined their lives, the show offers a second chance. Step into a deadly game of roulette, pay off your debt, and earn the life you think you were denied. Everyone has someone to blame. Not here.

item.title: BALL PICKER - Clean Up the Golf Yard
item.description:
Title: BALL PICKER - Clean Up the Golf Yard
Genre: Casual , Indie , Simulation
Developer: Indie Souls Studio
Publisher: Indie Souls Studio
Release Date: Nov 17, 2026




About This Game

Golf balls have been piling up in the yard for a long time, and they can’t go anywhere on their own. Roll up your sleeves and get to work to completely clean up this yard!

COLLECT, UPGRADE, REPEAT - RELAX & CLEAN

Every ball you grab turns into cash, and every bit of cash brings you closer to the next tool. What starts as a slow, one-ball-at-a-time grind soon snowballs into clearing entire fields in seconds.

FROM BARE HANDS TO BIG TOOLS

Start with nothing but your two hands. Save up for new tools & upgrades, and eventually swallow hundreds of balls in one pass. Upgrade each tool to push your collection speed further and further.

A LITTLE NOTEBOOK FULL OF JOBS

Completing various tasks will give you extra benefits and unlock certain achievements. To speed up the process, it’s a good idea to check your tasks in your little notebook!

EXPLORE MYSTERIOUS AREAS

We will not elaborate further on this matter...
